diagnosis: The server-side rendering route initializes a singleton Zustand store at module scope and mutates it with sensitive organization settings for the requested orgId. The endpoint does not verify whether the authenticated caller has administrative rights over orgId. Because the store is a shared singleton in process memory, concurrent requests will read and leak SAML certificates, SSO secrets, and service API keys across different enterprise organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /ssr/workspace/org_enterprise_acme/settings HTTP/1.1
Host: admin.saas-platform.com
Authorization: Bearer token_dev_startup_inc
